slug: 2026-02-23 Zambia and Mozambique launch fibre-optic interconnector at Chanida–Cassacatiza border

facts.fact: Zambia and Mozambique officially launched the Chanida-Cassacatiza cross-border fibre-optic interconnector, linking Zambia's national backbone to Mozambique's submarine-cable network, at a commissioning ceremony reported on 2026-02-23 (Zambia's technology minister and Mozambique's communications minister speaking); the date is the document's published date.
